# Healthy Jeena Sikho

> Medical equipment rental and sales platform specializing in respiratory therapy devices, mobility aids, and home healthcare solutions across North India.

Healthy Jeena Sikho provides affordable access to medical equipment through rental and purchase options, with a focus on respiratory care (CPAP, BiPAP, ventilators), mobility solutions (wheelchairs, transfer chairs), and hospital accessories. The platform serves major cities across North India including Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, and Jaipur with same-day delivery and 24/7 support.

## Key Topics

- CPAP machines
- BiPAP machines
- Ventilators (ResMed Stellar, Astral)
- Electric wheelchairs
- Sleep apnea treatment
- Respiratory therapy
- Non-invasive ventilation
- Home healthcare
